# Task Manager Agent

> A multi-agent task management system using OpenAI Agents SDK and FastAPI.

## Quick Start
- README.md: Full project overview, architecture, milestones, setup guide

## Key Documents
- PROJECT_JOURNEY.txt: Step-by-step build journey from diagram to working system
- AGENTS.md: System blueprint with architecture, agent roles, design principles
- docs/adrs/agent-decision.md: Architecture Decision Record — Simple Agent vs SandboxAgent
- spec/agents/sandbox-agent-spec.md: SandboxAgent specification
- spec/mcp/: MCP server specifications (transport, tools, implementation, testing, roadmap)

## Services
- services/task-mcp/: MCP server — 5 tools (capture, review, modify, resolve, remove)
- services/task-manager-agent/: Agent orchestrator

## Status
Completed: MCP Server, Docker, CI/CD, Agent SDK Research, Agent Testing (Gemini + MCP)
Next: SQLite Database, Multi-agent orchestration, Kubernetes
